meta.name: high-end-visual-design
meta.description: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页设计拥有高端品牌质感
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让AI生成的设计摆脱廉价感、更像专业工作室出品。
copy.tagline_en: Make web designs feel premium and agency-crafted
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI-generated designs to look expensive and professional.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 写网页 UI 代码时会按一套高端设计规范来：指定字体、间距、阴影、双层嵌套卡片结构、自定义动画曲线，并避开原文列出的默认廉价做法。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 写网页或前端 UI 代码（React、Tailwind、HTML 等）时触发；它会在写代码前先从原文的风格原型与布局原型中各挑一种。

say.text: 用高端设计风格帮我做一个 SaaS 落地页
say.note: 它会先选定风格与布局原型，再写代码

say.text: 把这个页面改成 Ethereal Glass 暗色风格
say.note: 套用深黑底、径向渐变与玻璃卡片

say.text: 重做导航栏，要浮动玻璃胶囊加汉堡展开动画
say.note: 用自定义缓动曲线和错峰揭示

howto.what_en: Claude writes web UI code against a high-end spec: set fonts, spacing, shadows, nested double-bezel cards and custom cubic-bezier motion, while avoiding the cheap defaults it lists.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to write web or front-end UI code (React, Tailwind, HTML); it first picks one vibe and one layout archetype before coding.

say_en.text: Build me a SaaS landing page in a high-end design style.
say_en.note: It first picks a vibe and layout archetype.

say_en.text: Redo this page in the Ethereal Glass dark style.
say_en.note: Applies OLED black, radial gradients, glass cards.

say_en.text: Rebuild the navbar as a floating glass pill with a morphing hamburger.
say_en.note: Adds custom easing and staggered reveals.
